crossRefs.note: Honor widows who are widows indeed.
But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay…
But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith, and is worse than…
If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it…
It is time to act, Yahweh, for they break your law.
My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.
“ ‘How do you say, “We are wise, and Yahweh’s law is with us?” But, behold, the false pen of the scribes has made that…
My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you…
For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth; for he is the messenger of…
making void the word of God by your tradition, which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”
Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.

translations.web: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.
translations.bsb: he need not honor his father or mother with it. Thus you nullify the word of God for the sake of your tradition.
translations.kjv: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.
translations.asv: he shall not honor his father. And ye have made void the word of God because of your tradition.
